title: 统计整数数目
summary: 统计闭区间 num1 到 num2 中，十进制数位和位于指定范围的整数个数，结果取模。
insight: 用数位 DP 计算从零到某上界的合法数量，状态是当前位置、当前数位和以及前缀是否贴紧上界。区间答案可写为 count(num2)-count(num1)+num1是否合法，避免对超长十进制字符串做减一。
pitfalls: 闭区间需要把 num1 本身补回来
非贴紧状态才可复用记忆
每一步都要取模并在数位和超过上限时剪枝

solutions.title: 上界数位动态规划
solutions.idea: 分别统计两个上界并用闭区间公式相减。
steps: 状态 pos,sum,tight；非 tight 状态记忆化
枚举当前位零到 limit，超过 maxSum 剪枝

code.java: class Solution { private static final int MOD=1000000007;private char[] digits;private int minSum,maxSum;private int[][] memo;private int dfs(int pos,int sum,boolean tight){if(sum>maxSum)return 0;if(pos==digits.length)return sum>=minSum?1:0;if(!tight&&memo[pos][sum]!=-1)return memo[pos][sum];int limit=tight?digits[pos]-'0':9;long ways=0;for(int digit=0;digit<=limit;digit++)ways=(ways+dfs(pos+1,sum+digit,tight&&digit==limit))%MOD;int answer=(int)ways;if(!tight)memo[pos][sum]=answer;return answer;}private int countUpTo(String bound){digits=bound.toCharArray();memo=new int[digits.length][maxSum+1];for(int[] row:memo)Arrays.fill(row,-1);return dfs(0,0,true);}private boolean valid(String value){int sum=0;for(char ch:value.toCharArray())sum+=ch-'0';return sum>=minSum&&sum<=maxSum;}public int count(String num1,String num2,int min_sum,int max_sum){minSum=min_sum;maxSum=max_sum;long answer=(long)countUpTo(num2)-countUpTo(num1)+(valid(num1)?1:0);answer%=MOD;if(answer<0)answer+=MOD;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val mod=1000000007;private lateinit var digits:CharArray;private var minSum=0;private var maxSum=0;private lateinit var memo:Array<IntArray>;private fun dfs(pos:Int,sum:Int,tight:Boolean):Int{if(sum>maxSum)return 0;if(pos==digits.size)return if(sum>=minSum)1 else 0;if(!tight&&memo[pos][sum]!=-1)return memo[pos][sum];val limit=if(tight)digits[pos]-'0' else 9;var ways=0L;for(digit in 0..limit)ways=(ways+dfs(pos+1,sum+digit,tight&&digit==limit))%mod;val answer=ways.toInt();if(!tight)memo[pos][sum]=answer;return answer};private fun countUpTo(bound:String):Int{digits=bound.toCharArray();memo=Array(digits.size){IntArray(maxSum+1){-1}};return dfs(0,0,true)};private fun valid(value:String):Boolean{var sum=0;for(ch in value)sum+=ch-'0';return sum in minSum..maxSum};fun count(num1:String,num2:String,min_sum:Int,max_sum:Int):Int{minSum=min_sum;maxSum=max_sum;var answer=(countUpTo(num2).toLong()-countUpTo(num1)+if(valid(num1))1 else 0)%mod;if(answer<0)answer+=mod;return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { static constexpr int MOD=1000000007;string digits;int minSum,maxSum;vector<vector<int>> memo;int dfs(int pos,int sum,bool tight){if(sum>maxSum)return 0;if(pos==(int)digits.size())return sum>=minSum;if(!tight&&memo[pos][sum]!=-1)return memo[pos][sum];int limit=tight?digits[pos]-'0':9;long long ways=0;for(int digit=0;digit<=limit;++digit)ways=(ways+dfs(pos+1,sum+digit,tight&&digit==limit))%MOD;int answer=ways;if(!tight)memo[pos][sum]=answer;return answer;}int countUpTo(const string& bound){digits=bound;memo.assign(digits.size(),vector<int>(maxSum+1,-1));return dfs(0,0,true);}bool valid(const string& value){int sum=0;for(char ch:value)sum+=ch-'0';return sum>=minSum&&sum<=maxSum;}public:int count(string num1,string num2,int min_sum,int max_sum){minSum=min_sum;maxSum=max_sum;long long answer=(long long)countUpTo(num2)-countUpTo(num1)+(valid(num1)?1:0);answer%=MOD;if(answer<0)answer+=MOD;return answer;} };
